# Lane ME verdict (generated by sim/verdict.py final from records/RESULTS.json; results are DEV)

**Verdict: UNCLEAR**

Gap = FP accuracy minus device accuracy (pp, test) for MNIST and CIFAR; LM = device bits per byte / FP - 1 (%).
Thresholds: < 2 pp; < 5 %. Forward and backward reads are ideal (the update is what is tested).

FP baselines: mnist 97.92 (sd 0.098, n 3); cifar 59.89 (sd 1.6, n 2); lm 2.879 (sd 0.059, n 2); LM Adam context 2.412 bpb
